title: asplenium jahandiezii
intro: Asplenium jahandiezii, commonly known as the Moroccan spleenwort, is a species of fern in the family Aspleniaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory conditions. The therapeutic actions of Asplenium jahandiezii include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects, which may contribute to its use in treating conditions such as bronchitis and coughs. The bioactive constituents of Asplenium jahandiezii have been reported to include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are thought to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
